shell.new.nothingAdmin: Issues, docs and other work come from modules. Enable one and what it makes shows up here.
shell.new.nothingMember: Issues, docs and other work come from modules. Once an admin enables one, what it makes shows up here.
shell.signIn.adminLede: Single sign-on is required for {workspace}. Only admins kept as a fallback can use a password.
shell.signIn.deactivatedBody: An admin turned it off, so signing in here won’t work. Ask a {workspace} admin to turn it back on in Settings › People.
shell.signIn.down: Your connection is fine; the server isn’t answering.
shell.signIn.expiredBody: For security, sessions end after a while or when an admin signs you out. Sign in to go back to where you were; everything you saved is still there.
shell.signIn.rateLimitedBody: To keep it safe, sign-in is paused for {wait}. Waiting does not lock you out. <link>Reset your password</link> if you’ve forgotten it.
shell.signIn.rateLimitedTitle: Too many attempts for this account
shell.signIn.retrying: Nothing you typed is lost. We’ll try again on our own in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.
shell.signIn.signedOutBody: You signed out of {workspace} on this browser.
shell.signIn.slow: Taking longer than usual… still trying.
shell.signIn.ssoRequiredBody: {workspace} signs people in through its identity provider. Only admins kept as a fallback can use a password.
shell.signIn.tellAdmin: If it lasts, tell whoever runs Bemmoly at {workspace}.
shell.signIn.timeout: The server took too long to answer.
shell.signIn.title: Sign in
